open_points.subject: Effect approval coverage vs credential rotation (M24 / State 0 decision 18)
open_points.text: "the fully built request as the owner was shown it — method, URL, headers and body. Any difference at send ... asks again" and "The credential's value is never shown, so rotating it voids nothing."
open_points.question: When a credential-backed header value changes, is that header value part of the approval match (`request_digest`) or explicitly excluded/normalized?
options: `request_digest` includes actual credential header values, so credential rotation voids prior approvals
`request_digest` excludes (or masks) credential values, so credential rotation does not void approvals
open_points.default_guess: Exclude/mask credential values from approval matching so rotation does not void approvals.

open_points.subject: Draft-write resend authority after `not_applied` (M26 vs K-08)
open_points.text: M26: "for a `draft-write` send [authority is] the flow activation ... — except a resend after `not_applied`, which, whatever its class, records the fresh approval it needed"; K-08: "a `draft-write` runs under the owner's activation of the flow instead"
open_points.question: If a `draft-write` attempt is concluded `not_applied`, must resend obtain a fresh per-effect owner approval, or continue to use flow activation authority?
options: Resend requires fresh per-effect approval even for `draft-write`
Resend for `draft-write` still uses flow activation (no per-effect approval)
open_points.default_guess: Keep `draft-write` under flow-activation authority (no per-effect approval).

open_points.subject: StandingGrant class applicability (M25 / State 0 grant action)
open_points.text: "grant a standing approval for a node of a flow's active version ..." with refusal only for "a `destructive` node"; K-08 runtime stop-for-approval is defined for `state-transition`, `external-effect`, `destructive`
open_points.question: Can standing grants be created for `read` or `draft-write` operation nodes (which do not stop for owner approval), or only for approval-gated classes?
options: Allow grants for any non-`destructive` operation node
Allow grants only for `state-transition` and `external-effect` nodes
open_points.default_guess: Restrict grants to nodes that otherwise require owner approval (`state-transition`/`external-effect`).

open_points.subject: Re-grant after revoke lifecycle for StandingGrant (M25)
open_points.text: "`grant_id`: minted at random by the kernel when granted" and lifecycle "`active` → `revoked`"
open_points.question: After revocation, does granting the same flow-version node create a new `StandingGrant` entity (new `grant_id`) or reactivate the revoked one?
options: Create a new grant record with a new `grant_id`
open_points.default_guess: Create a new grant record with a new `grant_id`.

open_points.subject: Multiplicity/addressing of EffectApproval requests for one waiting node (M24 / approve action)
open_points.text: M24 defines `approval_id` and statuses, and says a changed request causes a new approval request, but does not state cardinality per (`run_id`,`node_id`,`map_index`)
open_points.question: Can multiple `requested`/unused approvals coexist for the same run-node-map position, and which one does the owner's approve/refuse action target?
options: At most one open approval per run-node-map; new request replaces or is blocked
Multiple approvals may coexist; actions must target explicit `approval_id`
open_points.default_guess: Use explicit `approval_id` targeting and keep at most one open approval per run-node-map in normal flow.
